event.name: UBWC 2026
event.description: UBWC 2026 is being prepared for the 2026/27 Christmas and New Year break. The current proposed event window is 26 December 2026 to 2 January 2027; dates remain subject to organizer confirmation.

messages.registration: The target registration period is 11–20 December 2026. Registration is not open; the period will be confirmed by the organizers.
messages.schedule: A proposed schedule for 26 December 2026 to 2 January 2027 is available. Final dates are subject to organizer confirmation.
messages.qualifiers: The open qualifier is provisionally planned for 26 December 2026. Tournament links will be published after confirmation.
messages.players: The participant list will be published after registration opens.
messages.standings: Standings will be activated when official tournament results are available.
messages.results: Official results will be published during the competition.
messages.final: The three-day final is provisionally planned for 29–30 December 2026 and 2 January 2027.
